RS → OsmAnd on Android

Choose a route in RS on your phone, then send its complete path to OsmAnd whenever you want to navigate it.

Phone trial 0.1. The installer has been built and checked offline. The actual phone handoff and spoken guidance still need a phone test before use while driving.

Download the Android companion

  1. Download this signed installer on your Android phone. Open it and allow installation from that browser or file manager when Android asks. You can turn that permission off after installation.
  2. Install OsmAnd, download the map for your trip, and set its navigation profile to Driving.
  3. Open RS on this phone and sign in to your existing account. Choose your King of the Hill candidate in Choose or adjust.
  4. Tap Navigate in OsmAnd. In the companion, check the route name and tap Start chosen route in OsmAnd. For a larger route, RS downloads a .rsnav file instead; open that file with RS → OsmAnd.
  5. Check the resulting route in OsmAnd before driving. Return to RS to choose and send another route whenever needed.

What transfers

All chosen path points, in order, plus available turn reference points. The companion receives the route locally and grants OsmAnd read access to that route file. It has no internet or location permission.

RS exclusion zones do not transfer. Road matching, the approach from your current location, and later rerouting may change the path. OsmAnd supplies its own guidance; RS cannot verify that navigation started or monitor detours.
